release_notes: Build 59 fixes the Autopilot Needs You count so it shows the actual number of pending work items instead of the number of summary categories.
The Needs You stat and top Autopilot status now stay synchronized with Related Video, Instagram promo, packaging rescue, viewer reply, and release-warning item counts.
For the Build 58 example containing 1 Related Video, 8 Instagram promos, and 12 viewer replies, Autopilot now reports 21 need you rather than 3.
Completed work continues to reduce the count automatically while the unified Needs You task queue remains unchanged.
